The '''IC-360 camera droid''' was a small, round, hovering [[Droid/Legends|droid]] equipped with video cameras.

The [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[StarSpeeder 1000]]s carried one of these droids, as they were utilized for the passengers to observe the destined environment.

==Behind the scenes==
This droid's name is a play on "I See" and 360 meaning 360 degrees.
